kind: local pinned source inspection, not runtime qualification
finding: ImageData::new accepts an owning AsRef<[u8]> wrapper. new_file and full Blob::image_data share ImageData; sliced BlobBytes retains original Blob. An encoded-byte RAII owner can track the actual shared encoded container lifetime, but cannot prove decoded/native resource or mount retirement.
memory_source_finding: Blob URL resolution supplies shared ImageData in ImageSource.data; Context locates Location::Memory. Loader::read directly clones its ImageData and returns Ticket::done before L3 lookup/insertion. Other non-memory paths can retain encoded L3 entries.
allocation_limit: dynamic_worker::png returns Arc<[u8]> also retained by its separate 3-page/32MiB PNG cache. Wrapper final Drop proves shared ImageData container retirement, not underlying allocation freed or decoded/native resource retirement.
